Omni dialler plugin, a web phone for other systems, reopening finished conversations, ticket search by customer, a waiting-customer alert, spell check in replies, and a batch of fixes.

Yaxxa Omni (for Yaxxa Omni tenants, switched on per tenant by the platform): Yaxxa's AI agents and AI dialler manager work alongside a tenant's own Hodu dialler. The tenant connects its Hodu account and gets its own SIP trunk (IP and password) on the new Omni setup page; in Hodu it points its promotional campaigns, and agents' external transfers, at that trunk. Answered calls then reach a Yaxxa AI agent, which looks up the lead's details in the Hodu lead group (Check lead details shows which fields that tenant's Hodu returns, and the tenant picks which the AI may use), and the AI hands the call back to a Hodu queue or agent with a summary when a person is needed. The AI manager suggests or makes changes to the Hodu jobs the tenant chooses (pacing, schedule, pause and resume), within limits, with undo. Calls from unknown sources are still refused as before; only calls aimed at an Omni trunk are asked for a password. Help guides: Omni setup, connection, trunk, managing jobs.

Callbacks API: other systems can create, list, reschedule and cancel callbacks with an API key, and receive webhook events when a callback is due, completed or failed.

Web phone: other systems can put our phone in their own web pages with one script and a `<uceo-phone>` element, for dialling, answering, hold, transfer and call events. Logins are short-lived and belong to one agent, only the websites a tenant lists may use it (set under Developers), and cancelling a login signs the phone out at once. Developer guide in the help.

Reopening: a finished email or chat conversation can be reopened within 7 days, so one closed by mistake is no longer lost.

Tickets: search also finds a ticket by its customer's name, email address or phone number. A new ticket automation alerts the ticket owner and the team leader once when a customer's last message has had no reply for a set time (8 hours by default, off until you switch it on).

Replies: spell check now works in customer-facing reply boxes, in the organisation's language. In email replies on the agent desk, Enter starts a new line and Ctrl or Cmd with Enter sends.

Email: an email that continues none of our conversations now keeps the quoted thread below it, so agents see the history.

Live Monitor: a reply held back for the ticket's owner now says who it is held for and how long is left before it goes to the queue.

Fixes: Platform tenants shows a Tenant ID column; the Transcripts report labels a work item's result as Handling outcome, so an open ticket no longer reads Resolved."}
